name: auto-git-copilot
description: Automatically stage, commit, and push changes with AI-generated commit messages using GitHub Copilot

autoGitCopilot.enabled.description: Enable automatic git operations on file save

autoGitCopilot.delayMs.description: Delay in milliseconds before triggering git operations after file save (1000-30000ms)

autoGitCopilot.includeUntracked.description: Include untracked files in automatic commits

autoGitCopilot.maxCommitMessageLength.description: Maximum length for commit messages (20-200 characters)

autoGitCopilot.commitMessagePrompt.default:
Create a Git commit message that follows best practices.

The message should consist of a subject line and an optional but recommended body.

FORMAT RULES:
- The subject line MUST be imperative (e.g. ‘Fix bug’, ‘Add feature’).
- The subject line MUST be limited to 50 characters.
- The body MUST explain WHY this change is necessary and HOW it solves the problem.
- The body MUST be wrapped at 72 characters per line.

CODE DESCRIPTION:
{file_changes}
autoGitCopilot.commitMessagePrompt.description: Prompt template for the AI commit message generation. Use {file_changes} as placeholder for the diff.

autoGitCopilot.excludePatterns.description: File patterns to exclude from auto-commit (glob patterns supported)

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
